pr52.body:
## Why

C054 nominated a direct native128 pi specialization after the original cold lookup. That route still needs safe admission and unchanged rejected-path behavior before endpoint work. C055 finds that an eager admission charge can change the original callable captures and which exception occurs first.

## What this adds

This evidence-only checkpoint adds 49 files and preserves all 2,960 parent paths, blobs and modes.

- G0, eager charging followed by a fresh-expression fallback, is rejected by a conditional source witness with a normally returning callback.
- G1, retaining only outer callables and the first Fraction argument, still leaves original calls and comparisons before the checkpoint.
- G2, moving eager admission after the first atan square, still places a new callback before original F(0).
- The use-sensitive analysis excludes irrelevant defaults, unused Fraction fallback cells and unrelated caller state. Complete safe admission cost remains unknown. A provisional redundant 164-operation screen was withdrawn; no numeric cost rejection or universal impossibility is claimed.
- C056 asks for one explicit charge-bootstrap and continuation state machine. It must preserve original pending calls, locals and failure order, fund every operation once, and prove complete positive cost before any numerical work.

These are source counterexamples, not executed hostile requests or recording failures. No endpoint constants, implementation or collector are selected.

## Validation

Three independent final audits completed 53 substantive checks, with one wording issue corrected and reread and zero unresolved findings.

The unchanged documentation checker passed 29 preservation sources, 233 sections, 250 documents, 1,898 local links and 94 anchors. The metadata audit passed all 11 grouped checks. Each validation retained 898 stable inputs.

The partial snapshot contains 861 exact original files / 119,489,918 bytes, including all 243 parent Markdown/HTML documents and 20 local runtime modules. A separate complete remote comparison confirms all 65 runtime blobs equal held C035. Historical archives were checked as whole immutable blobs only.

All 49 additions / 1,193,517 bytes were fetched from immutable commit `8000959ad25e89d1794d1401c0f8c2960bcd18fc`, tree `5282f90bc12c321c67829ce6d7ce62c891b32424`, and matched exactly.

## Scope and continuation

No product imports, numerical execution, original/candidate request, collector, runtime test, benchmark, hosted dispatch or main merge occurred. Original recordings remain 24/28 historical; P11/P16/P23/L03 remain unresolved. C035 remains held, including adverse timing. All original limits and release gates remain.
